## ⚡ `whoami`

```yaml
name: Areesha
role: AI/ML Engineer
focus: [LLM Applications, RAG Systems, Autonomous Agents, NLP, Model Evaluation]
currently_building: multi-agent pipelines that occasionally agree with each other
currently_breaking: production, respectfully
status: shipping
```

I design and build **applied AI systems** — retrieval pipelines, agentic workflows, and evaluation harnesses that turn LLMs from cool demos into things that actually hold up in production. Comfortable across the whole stack: data → embeddings → retrieval → orchestration → model → eval → ship.

## 🧠 `what_i_work_on`

<table>
<tr>
<td width="50%" valign="top">

**🔗 LLM Applications**
Prompt/context engineering, structured outputs, tool-calling, and production-grade LLM APIs.

**📚 RAG Systems**
Hybrid retrieval (dense + BM25), chunking strategies, reranking, and grounding for reduced hallucination.

**🤖 Agentic Workflows**
Multi-step planners, tool-using agents, and orchestration across MCP-style tool ecosystems.

</td>
<td width="50%" valign="top">

**📊 Model Evaluation**
Building eval harnesses, LLM-as-judge pipelines, and regression tests for non-deterministic systems.

**🛠️ ML Systems**
Fine-tuning, embedding models, vector search infra, and serving pipelines end-to-end.

**🧩 NLP Foundations**
Classic + neural NLP, still useful even in the era of "just prompt it."

</td>
</tr>
</table>
